_comment: Weekly account-health watcher. Config over code: accounts, sources and thresholds live here. The scorer (automation/account_health_score.py) reads each account's evidence file and writes the log; the agent refreshes evidence from the sources first. Log-only: the daily rundown reads automation/logs/account-health-<date>.md. Nothing here sends.

sources.salesnav_alerts: Outlook, sender contains linkedin.com, trailing 7 days, names in watch_people

Value dispute.red: savings method disputed and no agreed review closed

Adoption decline.red: accept rate under goal two months running, or any rule paused

Executive change.red: sponsor, blocker or evaluator changed role

Competitive event.red: RFP, vendor evaluation or platform migration in flight

overall_rule: RED if any of Value dispute, Renewal clock, Competitive event is RED, or three or more codes are RED; YELLOW if any code is YELLOW or RED; else GREEN

digest.channel: Outlook or Teams for AM and Success, Slack for GTM (decision open)
digest.rollup_to: Mary Ann Chandler, one line per account, overdue items only
